##  Run scComp
Run the test for all the pairwise comparison in group column for all the cell types in annotation column. The figures and statistical results with be saved in the `output_dir` 

```{r,include=FALSE,message=F,eval=FALSE}
start_time <- Sys.time()
```


```{r,eval=FALSE}
# Metadata condition column to perform the comparison
sample_column <- "age.days."
run_sccomp(seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
           annotation_column = annotation_column,
           sample_column = sample_column,
           group_column = group_column, 
           output_dir = output_dir,
           n_jobs=1)
```

```{r,include=FALSE,message=F,eval=FALSE}
end_time <- Sys.time()
duration <- round(end_time - start_time,digits = 1)
print(duration)
```

After running the scComp test, the following figures will be generated.

### Boxplot
```{r, echo=FALSE,out.width="80%",out.height="80%"}
knitr::include_graphics("../../scDown_test/results/sccomp/vs_12/plots/scComp_boxplot.all_vs_12.png")

```

### 1D interval plot
```{r, echo=FALSE,out.width="80%",out.height="80%"}

```


### 2D interval plot
```{r, echo=FALSE,out.width="80%",out.height="80%"}
knitr::include_graphics("../../scDown_test/results/sccomp/vs_12/plots/scComp_2D_interval.all_vs_12.png")

```

**Note**: scComp relies on biological replicates for robust statistical modeling. Since this provided test dataset contains only one sample per condition, any resulting conclusions should be interpreted with caution.


The analysis was performed on a machine with the following specifications:

- **Operating System**: Rocky Linux 8.9 (Green Obsidian)
- **Product Name and Version**: RHEL
- **Product Version**: 8.9
- **CPU**: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum 8358 CPU @ 2.60GHz
- **Memory**: 10 GB
